title: ITIL: service, incident and change management

videos.script: The project ends. The software does not. It runs for years, and somebody has to keep it running. {{runs}} ITIL is the vocabulary of that work, and most large IT departments are organised around it. {{itil}} Monday morning: reminders have stopped being sent, for the third Monday in a row. {{monday}} Restarting the job brings them back. That restores the service. It does not explain anything. {{restore}} ITIL separates the two. An incident is about getting the service back. A problem is about the cause. {{separate}} This lesson computes a priority from two questions, follows a change down three different routes, and reads what the research says about change boards. {{tour}} It ends with what an architect decides, long before the first incident, that makes a system easy or miserable to run. {{architect}}
